newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Henderson Land says group debt reduced.
newsitem.headline: Henderson Land says group debt reduced.

text.p: Henderson Land Development Co Ltd said its consolidated outstanding borrowings had fallen by about HK$2.1 billion to about HK$16.9 billion during the period June 30, 1996 to October 31, 1996.

The company said in a statement on Wednesday that four series of Samurai bonds issued by the company in 1995 were given a "Single A plus" credit rating this week by the Japan Bond Research Institute compared with a previous "Single A" rating.
Henderson Land is planning to offer 33 million shares at HK$73.25 per share in a secondary listing in Tokyo.
